name: Wayland Unattended Access
description: Allows unattended remote connections to Wayland-based Linux sessions without requiring physical confirmation on the host.

name: P2P (Direct Connection)
description: Direct peer-to-peer connection between client and host, with support for tunneling over secure overlay networks (e.g. Tailscale) for NAT traversal without configuring public IPs.

name: Relay Server
description: Routes encrypted traffic through an intermediary relay server when a direct P2P connection is blocked by firewalls or strict NAT.

name: LAN Discovery
description: Automatically discovers available machines on the same local network via broadcast/multicast, without manually entering IP addresses or device IDs.

name: Tailscale Support
description: Built-in or straightforward support for connecting over the Tailscale mesh VPN, enabling secure access without configuring a public IP.

name: Open Source
description: Source code is fully open, allowing independent security audits and self-built clients.

name: Multi-Monitor Support
description: Displays multiple monitors from the remote computer at once, or allows quickly switching between them.

name: Drawing Tablet Support
description: Passes through input from graphics tablets (Wacom, Huion), including pen pressure sensitivity and tilt.

name: Gamepad Passthrough
description: Passes through and emulates game controllers (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro), including rumble/force feedback.

name: Audio Streaming
description: Streams high-quality, low-latency stereo audio from the remote system.

name: Microphone Passthrough
description: Streams audio from the client's microphone to the remote host (e.g. for calls or voice input).

name: Adaptive Bitrate
description: Dynamically adjusts the video stream's bitrate and quality based on current network conditions and available bandwidth.

name: H.264 Codec
description: Supports the widely compatible H.264/AVC video compression codec.

name: H.265 Codec
description: Supports the H.265/HEVC codec, reducing transmitted data volume while maintaining high quality.

name: AV1 Codec
description: Supports the modern, royalty-free AV1 codec for maximum compression efficiency.

name: V-Sync
description: Vertical frame synchronization to eliminate screen tearing and ensure smooth rendering.

name: Session Sharing
description: Allows multiple users to connect to the same active desktop or session simultaneously.

name: Multi-User Sessions
description: Supports multiple simultaneous, independent user sessions on a single host (isolated sessions, RDP-style).

name: Virtual Display
description: Creates software-based virtual monitors on the remote host, useful for headless servers or cloud VMs without a physical display.

name: 4:4:4 Chroma Subsampling
description: Supports full, uncompressed 4:4:4 chroma sampling, avoiding distortion of text and colors.

name: Frame Rate (FPS)
description: Supports high frame rates (60/120/144+ FPS) for maximum smoothness with dynamic content.

name: Session Recording
description: Records remote sessions to a video file for security audits and access control.

name: ISO Mounting
description: Remotely mounts ISO images and virtual drives on the target machine.

name: Wake-on-LAN
description: Remotely powers on or wakes a shut-down computer by sending a magic packet over the local network.

name: Pre-Login Access
description: Connects to the remote machine before user authentication (at the OS lock or login screen), e.g. right after a reboot.

name: No Account Required
description: Direct connections work without a mandatory account registration with the provider's cloud service.

name: KVM Integration
description: Integrates with hardware capture/control boards (KVM over IP) for low-level administration at the BIOS level.

name: Shared Clipboard
description: Bidirectional clipboard sync — copied text, images, or files are available on both machines.

name: SSO / OIDC
description: Integrates with enterprise identity providers (Azure AD, Okta, Google Workspace) for centralized single sign-on.

name: 2FA / MFA
description: Two-factor authentication to protect access to the management console, address book, and endpoint devices.

name: Address Book
description: Centralized address book with sync, device grouping, and team sharing.

name: Audit Logs
description: Centralized logging of all connections, authentication attempts, and settings changes for security audits and compliance.

name: Mass Deployment
description: Silent, automated installation (via MSI, scripts, or MDM) with preconfigured server-binding keys.

name: RBAC
description: Role-Based Access Control for granular permission management across admins and users.

name: Privacy Mode (Black Screen)
description: Blanks the remote computer's physical monitor and locks its local mouse/keyboard, so no one nearby can see what the remote user is doing.

name: Remote Printing
description: Print redirection — prints a document open on the remote computer to the client's local printer.

name: Generic USB Passthrough
description: End-to-end passthrough of any USB device over the network (license dongles, flash drives, 3D mice like SpaceMouse, non-standard hardware) — not limited to gamepads and tablets.

name: File Manager UI
description: A dedicated two-pane file manager interface for background file transfers, independent of the graphical session (in addition to standard drag & drop).

name: Text Chat
description: Built-in text messenger overlaying the remote screen, for communication between a support agent and the end user.

name: On-Screen Whiteboard
description: Annotation tools for drawing over the screen with a marker, to show the remote user where to click.

name: Proxy Support
description: Native support for connecting through corporate HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy servers to bypass strict firewalls.

name: UAC Handling
description: Allows remote interaction with Windows User Account Control (UAC) prompts — viewing, clicking, and approving elevated-privilege requests without losing session control or hitting a black screen.

name: HDR Support
description: Supports transmitting and displaying High Dynamic Range (HDR) video, preserving accurate color, high contrast, and detail in the remote session.

name: OTA Updates
description: Automatic over-the-air (wireless) updates for software/firmware.
